The Identity and Access Management API provides a [list of available account switch keys](https://techdocs.akamai.com/iam-api/reference/get-client-account-switch-keys).

items.docs: __All products__ When using Web Application Firewall in your security policy, this mode conveys how you're planning to keep the rules up to date, either `KRS` for manual updates or `AAG` for automatic updates. This operation returns which mode your rules are currently set to.

items.docs: __Kona Site Defender__, __App & API Protector with the Advanced Security module__, __Adaptive Security Engine__ The mode you set determines how your rule sets are updated. Use `KRS` mode to update the rule sets manually, or `AAG` to have them update automatically. If you're using Adaptive Security Engine, use `ASE_AUTO` to update the rules automatically, or `ASE_MANUAL` to update them yourself.
